_about: Titles, descriptions and robots settings for the hand-written pages. Each page supplies its own. Titles: 60 characters max, in the form 'Page Topic | Search Central Florida' (the build adds the ' | Search Central Florida' part). Descriptions: 155 characters max. Blog posts and event pages get theirs from their own data, not from this file.

index.html.description: Your guide to Orlando's best local art, music, markets and events, plus SEARCH, a snail mail club that sends local art to your mailbox every month.

events.html.description: Hand-picked Orlando events for the next seven days: live music, art shows, markets, comedy, film and workshops, on a calendar and a map.

mailclub.html.topic: SEARCH Snail Mail Art Club, Orlando
mailclub.html.description: A monthly snail mail club and Orlando art subscription box: prints and stickers from a local artist, plus perks from local businesses. From $6.99.

about.html.description: Search Central Florida is a hyperlocal guide to Orlando arts, culture and small businesses. Find something good, close the app and go.

submit.html.description: Hosting an event in Orlando? Submit it to the Search Central Florida events calendar. It's free, takes two minutes and needs no account.

admin.html.description: Private review dashboard for Search Central Florida event submissions.
